name: Omarchy Pets
author: Raiden-MeixElysia
description: An animated Codex Pets companion in the bar: it plays its own moves on a random schedule, looks at your cursor, and can be pinned to the desktop.

schema.label: Pet
schema.description: Directory name under the pets folder. Pick it from the panel.

schema.label: Pets folder
schema.description: Where Codex Pets packages are unzipped.

schema.label: Pinned
schema.description: Keep the pet on the desktop with the panel closed.

schema.label: Random behaviour
schema.description: Play a random move every 8-20 seconds.

schema.label: Animate
schema.description: Off shows a single still frame and runs no timer.
